Chapter 1419 - 4: Innate Five Great

Chapter 1419: Chapter 4: Innate Five Great

In the midst of chaos.

Lin Yuan’s slumbering consciousness gradually awakened.

"Have I already descended to the fourth source world?"

Lin Yuan diverted his mind to explore the surroundings.

At this moment, he still did not have the concept of ’eyes’.

Everything relied on his own perception.

"This time my vessel is a divine stone, an Innate Divine Stone."

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

After becoming a time life form, descending via the Myriad Realms Gate, he could actively choose his vessel.

And this time Lin Yuan chose the vessel of an Innate Divine Stone.

There was no choice; this source world was in its nascent stage, and everything was in a chaotic state, leaving few options for a vessel.

The Innate Divine Stone was the first divine stone nurtured by this source world; its natural aptitude was quite good, making it one of Lin Yuan’s best choices.

"The Dao manifests, the origin flows, tsk tsk..."

Lin Yuan merely probed slightly and sensed the ’vigorous vitality’ of the surrounding heavens and earth.

During the nascent period of the source world, the entire dimensional space had not yet taken shape.

At this time, the most precious Origin Dao to living beings was practically unveiled without any concealment.

In such a cultivation environment, even a pig would smoothly cultivate to the perfect twelfth tier.

Furthermore, during this period, the river of time had not yet condensed.

This meant that all the life birthed during this period would inherently be unfettered by the river of time.

No need for the ultimate leap from the eleventh to the twelfth tier.

As long as they didn’t perish midway, they would certainly possess the qualifications to become time life forms.

What’s more, the life forms that could be nurtured during the nascent stage of the source world were incredibly powerful, both in talent and aptitude.

It can be predicted that, in the long years to come, this world would essentially be ruled by the first batch of newly born life forms.

"According to the normal timeline, this Innate Divine Stone of mine would, after eons, nurture a powerful innate life."

Lin Yuan contemplated inwardly.

This was also the result of him observing the future timeline.

"Now that I have descended, there’s no need for an extended eon."

With a gentle movement of Lin Yuan’s mind, boundless Innate Chaos Qi began to surge towards him from all directions.

Passive cultivation is entirely different from active cultivation; moreover, Lin Yuan, as a time life form, had an absurdly high efficiency in active cultivation.

Merely a month passed.

The vessel Lin Yuan occupied, the ’Innate Divine Stone’, smoothly transformed.

Unlike nurturing life from within the Innate Divine Stone, directly transforming from the Innate Divine Stone allows maximum utilization of the stone itself.

"Finally, I can unleash my full potential."

A smile emerged on Lin Yuan’s face.

Prior to transforming, his essence was still that of an Innate Divine Stone, unable to move easily.

This was a limitation imposed upon him by the Dao of this Fang Yuan World.

But after transformation, these restrictions no longer applied.

"The consciousness of the source world hasn’t focused much on me?"

At the moment of transformation, Lin Yuan faintly sensed an invisible force descending and retreating instantly.

It was presumably the consciousness of the source world.

Lin Yuan’s premature transformation was entirely an anomaly, breaking conventional rules.

Normally, the first being to traverse this source world should not have been Lin Yuan.

Yet now Lin Yuan had achieved it, evidently exceeding the expectations of the source world consciousness.

In fact, even a Time Lord, such as the Lord of Heaven Light, paying a huge price to blend into a nascent stage source world wouldn’t dare act as Lin Yuan did, as they would be instantly detected and eradicated by the source world consciousness.

Once merged with a dimensional space, the strength of a Time Lord drastically declines, leaving them with little power to protect themselves.

At this point, facing erasure by the source world consciousness, the outcome can be imagined.

Therefore, after blending into a source world, even if Time Lords can observe future timelines and know of countless opportunities and advantages, they still dare not act excessively.

The various opportunities and benefits of a nascent-stage source world are mostly predetermined; which outsider dares meddle?

But Lin Yuan was different; he descended into this source world via the Myriad Realms Gate, perfectly blending in, so even with exhaustive probing from the source world consciousness, it would merely deem him as a native life form of the source world.

Even performing unconventional feats, the source world consciousness would take no action.

In the eyes of the source world consciousness, Lin Yuan, like any other nurtured life form, was its child.

As for the time life forms that infiltrate in? They are foreign usurpers, occupying nests of others, who would be erased without hesitation upon detection.

"Time to go out for a stroll."

Lin Yuan immediately began traversing the land of this nascent-stage source world.

At this time, the essential nature of the Origin Dao was openly displayed; for time life forms, the most precious essence of the Origin Dao was realized almost effortlessly.

"The essential laws of this source world’s Dao... are so unique..."

Lin Yuan’s eyes shone; every dimensional space had different essential laws for the operation of the Dao Origin, which is why time life forms must explore each dimensional space.

Even more so for the source world.

Compared to other dimensional spaces, the status and essence of a source world are higher, offering greater assistance to Lin Yuan.

"Besides comprehending the naturally manifested operations of the Dao Origin essence, I can also study the first batch of innate life nurtured by this Fang Yuan World."

Lin Yuan considered inwardly.

What is the most precious thing that a source world nurtures?

Treasures?

Marvels?

Or weapons?

None of these.

The most precious thing is life.

Because only life possesses infinite potential, only life holds the hope of breaking shackles.

Especially the first batch of life forms birthed during the nascent stage of a source world, they encompass a multitude of secrets of heaven and earth.
